body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.40 (naive sector base rate 0.46) that: Uniparts FY27 consolidated operating margin is >20.0%. Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5): p0 = 0.46 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', all-category fallback, n=5); SAC -8.1 pts x weight 0.701 (N=47) -> p = 0.40. Evidence: Q4FY26 call (26-May-2026): FY27 EBITDA 'above 20%'; Feb-26: '~20% through the cycle'. Screener OPM FY26 21.1% (247/1,171), H1FY27 22.7%, Q2FY27 21.9% (freight/tariff pressure flagged Nov-26). Resolution: YES if FY27 consolidated Operating Profit / Sales (screener; NSE XBRL as second source) is > 20.0%, to one decimal. Source: screener.in consolidated P&L + NSE XBRL. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.46 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', all-category fallback, n=5); SAC -8.1 pts x weight 0.701 (N=47) -> p = 0.40
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 4 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'margin' promises among the other auto-component peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=5, too few in category so all-category peer rate used). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if FY27 consolidated Operating Profit / Sales (screener; NSE XBRL as second source) is > 20.0%, to one decimal.

title: Paper call: Uniparts FY27 consolidated operating margin is >20.0%
